target_customer: DTC brands, SaaS companies and growth teams that buy paid advertising
problem: Creating, testing and managing paid ads across channels is slow and bottlenecked by human design and copy work.
business_model: Self-serve subscriptions ($99 and $599 per month) plus managed plans with a strategist
product_category: AI advertising agents (ad creative, campaign deployment, landing pages, ads in ChatGPT)

founders.name: Varunram Ganesh
prior_employers: MIT Media Lab (bitcoin research, about two and a half years)
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page; the site and YC listing differ on whether he is CEO or CTO.

founders.name: Sai Surbehera
prior_employers: Walmart Tech (ML engineer, search recall and reranking)

competitors.name: Amazon Ads agentic creative tool
competitors.what: Agentic tool that creates ads from concept to finished video or display for Amazon surfaces

competitors.name: Nativeads.ai
competitors.what: Generative AI for display and native ad creative tuned to brand tone

competitors.name: AdCreative.ai and Pencil
competitors.traction_then: Low-priced subscriptions, about $39 and $14 per month per an undated roundup

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating copy and images, deploying through ad APIs and creating landing pages uses existing models and APIs. Optimization feedback loops are the harder part.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded and big-platform competitors offer similar generation, and the product has already shifted focus once, suggesting low lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Meta, Google and Amazon each shipped AI ad creative tools in 2025.

market_need_then: Paid ads spend is large and teams want faster creative testing; the company claims 1,500 plus marketing teams and 30 plus enterprises, self-reported and unverified.

branding.domain_note: Uses trylapis.com with a try prefix as of 2025.

identity.visual_style: Product marketing site with named products ChatSense, OmniSense and RapidDomain
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and forward looking, short fragments, second person

brand_strength.rationale: Generic gemstone name shared with other Lapis products; no press about the brand was found.

pivots.from: AI search analytics to help brands rank on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini
pivots.to: AI agents that create and run paid ads end to end, including ads in ChatGPT
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page shows an earlier launch post with the analytics product. Exact date unknown.

outcome_analysis: Lapis is a Fall 2025 company with a small team that already moved from AI search analytics to ad generation. It faces large platforms shipping similar tools, and its traction numbers are self-reported. No exit or shutdown was found and no round was verified, so the outcome is open.
notes: Funding unverified: a startup database lists $500K seed; no press found. The first brand search returned only unrelated Lapis items. A second source claimed brand customers (Hyundai, Samsung, Domino's) that are unverified and not recorded. Founder education from one profile page was only seen in a search snippet, so left empty.
